senses.gloss: (cmp. כָּרָה) to encircle, twine around, embrace, wrap.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 39a:8">Men. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>תכלת שכ׳ רובה</he> a fringe the larger portion of which he twined together (v. <cite ref="V00547"><he>תְּכֵלֶת</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Menachot 39a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>כדי שיִכְרוֹךְ וישנה וכ׳</he> enough to twine around three times.
<cite ref="Yoma 38a">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="K01194"><he>כְּרָכָהּ</he></cite> embraced it (clung to the bronze door).
<cite ref="Shabbat 133b:5">Sabb. 133ᵇ</cite> <he>וכָרְכֵהוּ בשיראין נאין</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>וכוֹרְכוֹ</he>) and twine handsome ribbons around it.

<cite ref="Pesachim 115a">Pes. 115ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 79a">Zeb. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>היה כוֹרְכָן וכ׳</he> used to wrap them together (insert the Passover meat and the bitter herb between the Matsah).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:10">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כְּרָכוּהוּ בס״ת וכ׳</he> they wrapped him in a scroll of the Law and burned him. Tosef. Meg. IV (III), 20 <he>כּוֹרְכִין תורה וכ׳</he> you may wrap the Pentateuch in covers intended for &c.; (<cite ref="Megillah 27a:7">Meg. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>גוללין</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 4:8">Pes. IV, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2:19">Tosef. ib. II</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 3:19">III</cite>), 19 <he>כּוֹרְכִין את שמע</he> they recited the confession of faith (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:4">Deut. VI, 4</cite> sq.) in one <cite ref="K01187"><he>כֶּרֶךְ</he></cite>, without the proper pauses (or without inserting ‘Blessed be the Name of His glorious kingdom &c.’ between verses 4 and 5), v.
Pes. 56ᵃ, a. Y. ib. IV, 31ᵇ.—Part. pass. כָּרוּךְ, f. כְּרוּכָה; pl. כְּרוּכִים, כְּרוּכִין; כְּרוּכוֹת twined around, wrapped up; trnsf. (with אחר) clinging to, running after.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ber. V, 1</cite> <he>אפי׳ נחש כ׳ וכ׳</he> even if a serpent is wound around his heel, he must not interrupt his prayer, v. <cite ref="K01166"><he>כְּרִיכָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 66a:11">Kidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>הרי כ׳ ומונחת וכ׳</he> behold it (the Law) is wrapped up and lies in the corner, whoever wishes may study it.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> <he>בפנים כ׳ אני מהלך</he> I shall walk with my face wrapped up (in humility).—
<cite ref="Chullin 78b:11">Ḥull. 78ᵇ</cite> (expl.
<cite ref="Leviticus 22:28">Lev. XXII, 28</cite>) <he>מי שׁבנו כ׳ אחריו</he> that animal to whom the young clings (the mother).
<cite ref="Shabbat 52a">Sabb. 52ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="K01120"><he>כרוכין</he></cite> with the chain or halter twined around them, opp. <he>נמשכין</he> led by the chain &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 59b">Ḥull. 59ᵇ</cite> (<cite ref="S02108"><he>קרנים</he></cite>) <he>כרוכות</he> horns the layers of which encircle one another.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 33">Ex. R. s. 33</cite> <he>היו כ׳ זה בזה</he> their bodies were twisted around each other; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be twined around; to be wrapped up. Y. Ter. VII, 46ᵇ bot. יִכָּרֵךְ המת בסדינו shall the dead be wrapped up in his sheet?, i.e. shall that man be abandoned to his fate?—
units: <cite ref="Yoma 69a:5">Yoma 69ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא תִכָּרֵךְ וכ׳</he> lest one thread wind itself around (stick to) his body.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 3">Ab. d’R. N. ch. III</cite>, beg. <he>המַכְרִיךְ סמרטוטין וכ׳</he> he who ties a bandage over his eyes (pretending blindness) &c.

<cite ref="Menachot 39a:8">Men. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ לא כי׳ בה וכ׳</he> even if he formed only one link by winding the twine around. Y. Ḥag. III, 79ᵃ top <he>וִיכָרְכֶינָּה בסיב ויטבילה</he> let him wrap bast around it and so immerse it; ib. II, end, 78ᶜ (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 9:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IX, 6</cite> <he>שהוא מְכָרֵךְ בו וכ׳</he> which one twines around the couch.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 9:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מַכְרִיךְ</he>.—Part. pass. <he>מְכוֹרָךְ</he>, pl. <he>מְכוֹרָכִין</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 35">Lev. R. s. 35</cite> <he>הסייף … ניתנו מכ׳ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 40:14">Sifré Deut. 40</cite> <he>כְּרוּכִים</he>) the sword and the book have been handed from heaven wrapped up together; a. e.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 6:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01208"><he>כִּרְכֵּם</he></cite>.]
